title: Scoped PRD: SAML/SSO & Key Custody Options — Clarifications, Scope Tranches, and Compliance Acceptance Criteria
creator: Marina Ortiz
description: This PRD clarifies scope and acceptance criteria for identity and key custody integrations in Private deployments. It enumerates three scope tranches (MVP, Enterprise, Regulated), lists trade-offs for KMS vs HSM options, defines RBAC surface area and audit log requirements, and provides a sign-off checklist for security and compliance stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Customers can configure a SAML IdP via Console with test login flow and SAML metadata export/import; End-to-end SSO validated in private VPC with sample IdP (Okta) and documented failure modes.
RBAC: Role model implemented for Admin/Operator/Viewer with resource-scoped policies; API and Console honor RBAC decisions and unit/integration tests cover enforcement paths.

Audit logs: Immutable audit record for admin actions, key usage events, and system rollbacks; logs delivered to customer sink (S3/GCS) and retained per configured policy; sample queries for key rotation events included.

KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys supported via KMS integration with CMK import & envelope encryption; HSM route documented with attestation requirements and automated key rotation option for enterprise tranche.
Upgrade/rollback: Private control plane schema changes are backward compatible for one minor release; rollback checklist validated in staging with test plan and runbook.
Security sign-off: Compliance, Security Engineering, and Customer Success have approved the risk assessment and mitigation matrix for the targeted tranche.
Documentation: Admin guide, runbooks, and upgrade notes published in Confluence; example terraform modules and a sample onboarding checklist shipped in repo.

open_questions: Should we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO for MVP or defer IdP-initiated to Enterprise?
What level of key provenance metadata is required for HSM attestation reports to satisfy auditors?
Is per-organization KMS policy mapping required for MVP or can we provide only a single customer CMK mapping?
What SLA commitment (RTO/RPO) will apply to key management operations in Dedicated vs Private deployments?
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Misconfiguration of SAML leading to broken login flows. Mitigation: automated test harness and explicit guided test step in Console.
Risk: Key leakage during migration. Mitigation: envelope encryption, zero-knowledge transfer patterns, and mandatory rotation validation.
Risk: Audit log tampering. Mitigation: append-only logs, signed log batches, and customer-side delivery to reduce single-point-of-failure.
Risk: Increased latency for key operations in HSM mode. Mitigation: cached key-encryption results, async rotate paths, and SLO adjustments for regulated tranche.
